note: RQ5-M memory diagnostics, run outside the frozen script (2026-10-30). Ollama 0.40.13, CPU-only, all other models unloaded first.
cause: Ollama launches llama-server.exe without --cache-ram, so llama.cpp's default host-RAM prompt cache (max 8192 MiB) applies. Each distinct prompt adds ~40 MB of private memory until the cap. Runner command line: -c 4096 -np 1 --flash-attn auto -b 512 -ub 512 --context-shift --keep 4 (no --cache-ram).
correction_to_deviation_2: rq5m_unload_fix.json attributed the run-2 peaks to other resident models. Run 3, with every model unloaded first, gave 4,872 / 2,222 / 849 MB, about the same as run 2 (4,563 / 2,142 / 848). That attribution was wrong; the peaks reflect prompt-cache growth over 121 requests. The unload fix stays in place (harmless and correct practice).
